messages.en:
{07 14 00}Don't you think{01 00 00 0a 00} excavating
fossils is kind of like
finding love, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}You look and you look,{01 00 00 0a 00} and
once you find something
that you really like, 
{07 14 00}you want to display it for
all the world to see,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}! Am I right?
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kas sa ei leia,{01 00 00 0a 00} et fossiile
kaevata on natuke nagu
armastust leida, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Sa otsid ja otsid,{01 00 00 0a 00} ja
kui leiad midagi,
mis sulle tõesti meeldib,
{07 14 00}tahad seda kogu maailmale
näidata,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}! Kas pole nii?

messages.en:
{07 19 00}I don't think fossils{01 00 00 05 00} feel
bad about being dug up
by me, {04 02 00}.
{07 0a 00}I think of it as, like,{01 00 00 14 00} a
fated encounter that has
transcended centuries!

{07 19 00}Iron men of fossil hunting{01 00 00 0a 00}
will get down and listen to
the dirt, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}You know, {01 00 00 0a 00}I'll bet
that sound would be worth
more than the fossils!
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Fossiilijahi raudmehed{01 00 00 0a 00}
heidavad maha ja kuulavad
mulda, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Tead, {01 00 00 0a 00}vean kihla,
et see heli oleks väärt
rohkem kui fossiilid!

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Check out my ensemble here,
OK? {01 00 00 0a 00}Does it say to you I'm
searching for...{02 01 00 0a 0b 0c}
Fossils?
Love?
My true self?
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Vaata mu kokkupanekut,
eks? {01 00 00 0a 00}Kas see ütleb sulle,
et ma otsin...{02 01 00 0a 0b 0c}
Fossiile?
Armastust?
Oma tõelist mina?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}They say{01 00 00 0a 00} this is the most
effective way to walk,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 17 00}Because I'm carrying a
{ff 00 00 07}shovel{ff 00 00 00}, I'm working my arms
as well as my legs!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Öeldakse,{01 00 00 0a 00} et see on kõige
tõhusam viis kõndida,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 17 00}Kuna ma kannan
{ff 00 00 07}labidat{ff 00 00 00}, treenin nii käsi
kui jalgu!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}It's weird. I'm actually not
that interested in fossils{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 19 00}But I think balance is the
key to life, so I want to
try a variety of hobbies!
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Imelik. Tegelikult ei
huvita fossiilid mind eriti{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 19 00}Aga minu arust on tasakaal
elu võti, nii et tahan
proovida mitmeid hobisid!

messages.en:
{07 09 00}{01 00 00 05 00}I'm just making small talk,
{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 15 00} Sheesh!
Sensitive much?
Someone's gotta keep this
chat going, and you aren't
exactly a sparkling wit.
{07 19 00}{01 00 00 05 00}See how I deftly dug my way
out of that one,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}? Now that's wit!
messages.et:
{07 09 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Ma lihtsalt lobisen,
{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 15 00} Oih!
Kas oled tundlik?
Keegi peab seda juttu
üleval hoidma ja sina just
sädelev vaimukus pole.
{07 19 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Näed, kui osavalt ma end
sellest välja kaevasin,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}? See on vaimukus!

messages.en:
{07 02 00}Are you being sarcastic,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?! {01 00 00 0a 00}Well! Don't you
sass me!
{07 05 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Sure, it was a pun,{01 00 00 0a 00} but it's
funny 'cause it's not funny!{01 01 00}
Like a relationship!
messages.et:
{07 02 00}Kas sa oled sarkastiline,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?! {01 00 00 0a 00}No kuule! Ära
ole nii nipsakas!
{07 05 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Jah, see oli sõnamäng,{01 00 00 0a 00} aga
naljakas just sellepärast!{01 01 00}
Nagu suhe!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Oh, yes, {01 00 00 05 00}you find the most
interesting things in the
dirt, like {01 00 00 0a 00}boys, {04 02 00}.
{07 01 00}{01 08 00}But it's not like boys are
all I care about! I do have
intellectual pursuits, too!{03 02 00 01}
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Oh jaa, {01 00 00 05 00}mullast leiab
kõige huvitavamaid asju,
näiteks {01 00 00 0a 00}poisse, {04 02 00}.
{07 01 00}{01 08 00}Aga poisid pole ainus, mis
mind huvitab! Mul on ka
intellektuaalseid huvisid!{03 02 00 01}

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} I think you
finally found your sense of
humor!
{07 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}I guess it was buried in the
dirt, too! Hee hee hee! {01 00 00 0a 00}
{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Oi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} Sa vist
leidsid lõpuks oma
huumorimeele!
{07 03 00}{01 00 00 05 00}See oli vist ka mulda
maetud! Hihihii! {01 00 00 0a 00}
{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}I'm dishing the dirt with a
shovel in my hand{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 01 00} {07 14 00}Tee hee!{02 00 00 08 09}
Trash talker!
Hee-larious!
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Ma pinnin mulda, labidas
käes{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 01 00} {07 14 00}Hihii!{02 00 00 08 09}
Keelepeksja!
Naljakas!
